newsitem.title: USA: Bio-Vascular Vital Signs spinoff effective.
newsitem.headline: Bio-Vascular Vital Signs spinoff effective.

text.p: Bio-Vascular Inc said Monday a spinoff to shareholders of its wholly owned subsidiary, Vital Images Inc, is effective, according to the Securities and Exchange Commission.

Bio-Vascular shareholders of record on May 5, 1997, will receive one share of Vital Images common stock for each two shares of Bio-Vascular common stock held. Cash will be issued in lieu of fractional shares.
Bio-Vascular also said that the effective date of the distribution will be May 12, 1997, at which time Vital Images will be an independent public company.
Vital Images is initially expected to trade in the over-the-counter market on the OTC Electronic Bulletin Board with the expected symbol VTAL.

Bio-Vascular makes and markets specialty medical products for use in thoracic, cardiac, neuro and vascular surgery. Vital Images develops computer software for medical research, clinical diagnosis and surgical planning.
